category_description: Buying a home in Canada: first-home programs, down payments and mortgages.
subcategory_description: Down payments, mortgage insurance and the rules for buying a home.
label: Purchase price up to which the lower down payment rate applies
context: The 5% minimum applies to the first part of the price up to this amount.

label: Minimum down payment on the first part of the price
context: Applies to the whole price of a home at or below the threshold, and to the first part of a higher price.

label: Minimum down payment on the part of the price above the threshold
context: Applies to the portion of the price above the threshold, up to the price cap for insured mortgages.

label: Price cap for CMHC-insured homeowner mortgages
context: The purchase price must be below this amount for the mortgage to be CMHC-insured.

label: Minimum down payment at the price cap and above
context: Applies to homes that cost the price cap or more.

label: Lowest mortgage loan insurance premium
context: A share of the mortgage amount. The premium depends on the size of the down payment.

label: Highest mortgage loan insurance premium
context: A share of the mortgage amount. A bigger down payment means a lower premium.

subject_intro: The minimum down payment for a home at each price level, when mortgage loan insurance is needed, what it costs and where the down payment can come from.
subject_meta_description: The minimum down payment is {fact:ca_dp_low} on the first {fact:ca_dp_tier} of the price and {fact:ca_dp_high} above it. See when mortgage insurance is needed and the price cap.
